seoTitle: How to Bulk Edit Issues in Jira Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to select multiple Jira issues at once and use the bulk change feature to update fields, status, and assignees faster.
intro: Editing Jira tickets one at a time can eat up a lot of time when you're managing dozens of tasks, but the bulk change feature lets you update many issues at once. This guide covers selecting multiple issues, using the bulk change option, and updating status, fields, and assignees efficiently.

steps.heading: Select multiple issues
steps.body: From your Jira issue list or board, select the tickets you want to edit together using the multi-select checkboxes.

steps.heading: Open the bulk change option
steps.body: With issues selected, choose the bulk change action from the tools menu to begin editing them as a group.

steps.heading: Change issue status for multiple tickets
steps.body: Use the bulk change workflow to move several tickets to a new status at once instead of updating each individually.

steps.heading: Edit fields and assignees
steps.body: Bulk change also lets you update fields like assignee, priority, or labels across all selected issues in one action.

steps.heading: Review changes before confirming
steps.body: Jira typically shows a preview of the bulk change before applying it, so double-check the selected issues and updates are correct.

faq.question: How many Jira issues can I bulk edit at once?
faq.answer: Jira supports selecting and bulk editing a large number of issues at once, though very large batches may need to be split depending on your instance's performance.

faq.question: Can I change assignees in bulk in Jira?
faq.answer: Yes, the bulk change feature lets you reassign multiple issues to a different user in a single action.

faq.question: Does bulk changing status trigger workflow transitions?
faq.answer: Yes, bulk status changes follow the same workflow rules as individual transitions, so restricted transitions still apply.

faq.question: Is bulk edit available on all Jira plans?
faq.answer: Bulk change functionality is a core Jira feature available across standard plans.
